headline: Failed House rule that would have set debate terms for three measures on settlement donations, joint employer rules, and EV charger requirements.
what_it_does: This resolution would have set the rules for how the House debates and votes on three other measures. One was a bill (H.R. 788) to limit donations made as part of legal settlements involving the United States. The other two were resolutions to overturn a National Labor Relations Board rule on when companies count as joint employers, and a Federal Highway Administration rule waiving Buy America requirements for electric vehicle chargers. By itself, it would not have changed any law; it would only have allowed those measures to come to the House floor under set terms.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: It would have set the procedures and time limits for debating and voting on the three measures.
